changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE inscriptions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seed_time VARCHAR(20)
ALTER TABLE inscriptions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'EN_ATTENTE'
ALTER TABLE inscriptions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS registered_at TIMESTAMP
UPDATE inscriptions SET status = statut WHERE status IS NULL AND statut IS NOT NULL
UPDATE inscriptions SET registered_at = date_inscription WHERE registered_at IS NULL AND date_inscription IS NOT NULL
UPDATE inscriptions SET status = 'EN_ATTENTE' WHERE status IS NULL
UPDATE inscriptions SET registered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE registered_at IS NULL
ALTER TABLE inscriptions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS date_inscription
ALTER TABLE inscriptions DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS statut
ALTER TABLE inscriptions ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE inscriptions ALTER COLUMN registered_at SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE inscriptions ALTER COLUMN epreuve_id SET NOT NULL
